description.value: Value set combining the distinct value sets that the zib AddressInformation binds to for NL-CM:20.5.5 Country. This value set as such does not exist in the zib but facilitates referencing all these value sets at the same time./nThis value set is the counterpart of the [LandCodelijsten used in zib publication 2020](http://decor.nictiz.nl/fhir/ValueSet/2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.60.121.11.10--20200901000000) and has been published by MedMij as it has not (yet) been made available by Nictiz within ART-DECOR.
